description: This file defines a context manager to block certain session mutation methods in PySpark pipeline definitions, preventing imperative constructs from executing. It includes method replacements with exception-raising stubs and restores original methods after use.

classes.name: None
classes.description: Contains helper functions and a context manager for blocking session mutation methods in PySpark.

methods.name: _create_blocked_method
methods.description: Creates a method that raises a PySparkException when called, used to block certain session mutation methods.

methods.name: block_session_mutations
methods.description: A context manager that temporarily replaces specified PySpark session mutation methods with blocked versions that raise exceptions.
